name: Brigatinib
mechanism: ATP-competitive ALK inhibitor with broad activity against ALK resistance mutations and substantial CNS activity.
keyToxicities: Early-onset pulmonary events (interstitial lung disease/pneumonitis) shortly after initiation, mitigated by a lead-in dosing schedule
monitoring: Close respiratory monitoring during the first week of treatment and after dose re-escalation
interactions: Avoid strong CYP3A inhibitors and inducers. May reduce efficacy of hormonal contraceptives.
resistance: G1202R and compound ALK mutations; bypass signalling.
